title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Governance and Patient Safety of Clinical AI Triage Tools in Acute Care Hospitals
abstract: Clinical AI triage tools deployed in emergency departments reduce wait times by 18% under continuous algorithmic audit and human-in-the-loop oversight, maintaining full compliance with medical device regulations.
venue: New England Journal of Medicine AI

title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Regulatory Compliance and Risk Mitigation for Hospital Clinical Decision Support Systems
abstract: Hospital governance committees report that multi-tier validation protocols prevent diagnostic bias and align institutional AI triage tools with EU AI Act and FDA digital health safety frameworks.
